note: Round-8 review, all three models: a signature under a verification result, an acceptance of risk, and a contractual liability are different acts with different subjects. One field cannot carry all three. These roles are what a bundle may contain; liability is deliberately NOT here, because a JSON file cannot create a contract.

analysis_provenance.asserts: this bundle was produced by this analysing agent from these inputs

process_attestation.asserts: this bundle was produced by this harness, unmodified

consistency_verdict.asserts: the claim does not exceed the evidence, under this policy
consistency_verdict.may_be_held_by: the verification party, which must not be the acceptance party

risk_acceptance.asserts: a named party accepts the residual risk of this bundle for a stated period
risk_acceptance.may_be_held_by: the party that owns the risk, never the tool

not_a_role.liability_agreement: a contract, not a signature. It may be referenced by a field, and the bundle must not imply that its existence creates one.

separation_of_duties.rule: risk_acceptance and consistency_verdict may not be signed by the same key
separation_of_duties.why: the party that checks the claim cannot also be the party that accepts what the check could not establish; otherwise the second signature adds nothing a reader can rely on
